    timeframe = "5m"

    reference_low = ta.value_when(0, escape_bar, low)

    trend_exit = ta.crossunder(close, trend_fast)
    long_exit = failed_breakout_exit or trend_exit
    reentry_ready = state.ready_after(long_exit, cooldown_bars)
    long_entry = not sideways and trend_ok and reentry_ready and confirmed_breakout
